tasks.title: Build a Sentence
Car Rental Feedback
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently rented a car for a weekend trip with your dorm mate and were satisfied with the vehicle's performance. However, you had a bad experience with the customer service at the rental office. You want to provide feedback to the rental company manager, Ms. Turner.
bullets: Explain what features of the car you liked most.
Describe the issues that occurred during your customer service experience.
Suggest ways to improve the pick-up and drop-off process.
tasks.subject: Feedback on Car Rental Experience
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms. Turner,

I recently rented a compact car for a weekend trip and was satisfied with the vehicle itself. It was clean, easy to park, and used less fuel than I expected, which made the trip more comfortable.

Unfortunately, the customer service at the rental office was not as reliable. At pick-up we waited more than forty minutes, and the staff could not find our reservation until we showed the confirmation email. At drop-off, nobody was available to inspect the car, so we were unsure whether the return had been recorded.

A simple check-in list, a visible queue number, and a short drop-off confirmation would prevent this confusion. I hope this feedback helps the office match the quality of the cars you provide.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
tasks.analysis: 邮件需覆盖三点：喜欢的车况、客服问题、取还车改进。称呼 Ms. Turner。

tasks.title: Brand Loyalty
tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: We've been discussing various strategies to build brand loyalty. One effective strategy is offering personalized services and products to customers. Personalization can make customers feel valued and understood. Do you think personalization is the key to building strong brand loyalty? Why or why not?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: Personalization makes customers feel valued and more likely to stick with the brand. It creates a unique customer experience that sets the brand apart from competitors.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: In my opinion, while personalization is important, it's not the only factor in building brand loyalty. Other aspects like customer service, product quality, and pricing also play a significant role. A balanced approach is needed to maintain strong brand loyalty.

tasks.sample: I agree with Andrew that personalization helps, but it is not the only key to brand loyalty. Personalized recommendations can make a customer feel recognized, as Claire says, and streaming services show how that unique experience keeps people subscribed. Still, if the product is unreliable or the price jumps without warning, even a perfectly tailored homepage will not keep buyers. In my experience, loyalty lasts when personalization is paired with consistent quality and responsive service. A store that remembers my size but ships damaged goods will lose me; a brand that gets both right is much harder to leave. So personalization is a strong tool, not the whole strategy.
tasks.analysis: 需表态并回应对方。较好答法：个性化有用，但质量、服务、价格同样关键，并举例。
